latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Trading Coach — an AI-powered trading review tool.

- Automatically imports and matches trading records from major Chinese brokerages (Futu, Tiger, CITIC, Huatai, etc.).
- Generates professional-grade review reports and actionable improvement insights based on broker CSV files.
- Provides 8-dimension position scoring (entry/exit/trend/risk/behavior/news/execution...)
- Delivers 10-dimension AI-powered trading analysis, highlighting patterns and areas for improvement.
- Supports quickstart CLI workflow and detailed scoring/insight documentation.
- Outputs clear summaries of trading statistics and personalized recommendations.
